battle.name: 國民政府東征
battle.brief: 1925年國民政府東征中，國民革命軍在廣東惠州與陳炯明部交戰，葉挺率領的第四軍獨立團參與惠州戰役，戰局由粵東向湖南延伸。英國海軍於1877年列裝的Torpedo boat則代表當時近海警戒與魚雷突擊的海上裝備。

kit.name: 魚雷艇
kit.history: Torpedo boat是英國海軍早期魚雷艇，主要執行近海巡弋、沿岸警戒與魚雷突擊，憑藉高速小噸位打擊近岸小型艦艇，並支援封鎖與偵察。

countries: 這裡的「國民政府東征」專指1925年的第一次東征，即廣州國民政府與國民革命軍在中國內戰背景下討伐陳炯明所部、打通並控制粵東的作戰，不把同年開始的北伐或1926年的第二次東征混入同一戰役。交戰雙方都是中國境內的政治軍事集團，而不是兩個主權國家：一方是1912年成立的中華民國，其北京政府到1924年已受張作霖控制，而廣州國民政府以中央政府自居，旗下正在整編的國民革命軍則是主要作戰力量；另一方是陳炯明以救粵軍等武裝名義控制惠陽、潮汕並進攻廣州的反政府聯軍。俄國軍事顧問曾參與黃埔訓練與參謀準備，但俄羅斯不是作戰國。戰區由廣州以東的東莞、惠陽、淡水、海豐一路延至潮陽、澄海、潮州與汕頭，因此這是一場以省內軍事統一、排除廣州外圍威脅及建立中央指揮體系為目標的國內戰爭。
countriesEn: The Nationalist Government Eastern Expedition discussed here is specifically the First Eastern Expedition of 1925: an operation by the Guangzhou Nationalist Government and its National Revolutionary Army against Chen Jiongming's forces within the framework of Chinese civil war, intended to open and control eastern Guangdong. It is not the Northern Expedition begun in the same year or the Second Eastern Expedition of 1926. Both belligerents were domestic Chinese political-military organizations rather than sovereign states. One side was the Nationalist Government at Guangzhou, which claimed to represent the central government of the Republic of China after the Beijing authorities had come under Zhang Zuolin's control in 1924; its principal instrument was the newly reorganized National Revolutionary Army. The other was Chen Jiongming's anti-government coalition, operating under names such as the Jueyue Army and controlling areas around Huizhou and Chaoshan while threatening Guangzhou. Russian military advisers helped with Whampoa training and staff preparation, but Russia was not a belligerent. The operational area ran from Dongguan, Huizhou, Danshui, and Haifeng eastward to Chaoyang, Chenghai, Chaozhou, and Shantou. The campaign was therefore a domestic war aimed at military unification within Guangdong, removing the immediate threat to Guangzhou, and establishing a central command structure.
people: 孫中山是廣州國民政府最高政治主持者，東征所需的經費、武裝整合與政治授權集中反映他對消滅陳炯明、穩定廣州及推進全國軍事統一次序的判斷。蔣介石以國民革命軍總司令身分主持東征，負責擬定大體作戰方案、配置行軍序列與指揮部隊；東征初期建制仍在調整，他的主要作用是將黃埔軍校骨幹、受整編的廣東軍及外省部隊納入同一作戰體系。李濟深等廣東軍系首領是此役的重要支柱，提供兵員、地方防務經驗與前線配合，但其正式職務及部隊番號曾隨整軍而變動，不宜把後來北伐期的固定軍制倒套到本役。黃埔軍校早期畢業生與在校生大量充任連、排長及參謀骨幹，在作戰中獲得第一次大規模實戰歷練。蘇聯軍事顧問瓦西里·布留赫爾，即通常所稱的加倫，影響了黃埔訓練和參謀準備，但不宜誇大為所有戰役決策的唯一來源。陳炯明是對方的最高統帥，率救粵軍系統作戰；其屬各部指揮關係同樣鬆散，地方與外來武裝間的合作時有變化，雙方指揮體系的成熟程度並不相同。
peopleEn: Sun Yat-sen was the highest political authority of the Guangzhou Nationalist Government. His decision to remove Chen Jiongming, stabilize Guangzhou, and establish conditions for broader military unification shaped the campaign's funding, armament policy, and political authorization. Chiang Kai-shek, commanding the National Revolutionary Army, directed the expedition, established its broad operational plan, arranged the march order, and coordinated the field forces. Because the army was still being reorganized in the opening phase, his achievement was the integration of Whampoa cadres, reorganized Guangdong troops, and contingents from other provinces into one operational system rather than the administration of a fixed order of battle that already resembled the later Northern Expedition. Military leaders such as Li Jishen were important local pillars, providing troops, regional experience, and front-line cooperation, although their formal posts and unit designations continued to change during the reorganization. Early Whampoa graduates and cadets served widely as company and platoon commanders and staff officers, gaining their first large-scale combat experience. The Soviet adviser Vasily Blyukher, generally known as Galen, influenced Whampoa training and staff preparation, but it would be excessive to attribute every operational decision to him. Chen Jiongming was the overall commander of the opposing Jueyue Army network. His subordinate command relationships were also loose, cooperation among local and outside armed groups varied, and neither side possessed an equally mature command system.
kits: 1925年的武器裝備仍以第一次世界大戰後引進的中日歐制式為主，沒有足以決定戰局的裝甲車或現代航空力量。東征軍步兵主要使用漢陽88式步槍、馬瑟1889式及1905式步槍，陳炯明所部除使用同類步槍外，也有日制三八年式步槍；機槍以Maxim M1897與Schwarzlose M1907／12為代表。炮兵可見漢陽88式野戰炮及Krupp 75毫米山炮，前者適合在道路與射界較開闊處提供曲射支援，後者可用馬匹或馱畜分件運輸，較能沿粵東道路向前機動。步兵配有Brandt 60毫米迫擊炮，並使用Mills手榴彈及軍用刺刀；軍官常備Browning M1903手槍或Mauser C96。少量Ford Model T載貨車可用於廣州後方至前線補給站之間的短程運輸，但道路、橋梁、燃料與車況限制其無法取代畜力和車輛。各種型號在部隊間配置並不一致，許多地方軍還混用舊式槍械；作戰效能主要取決於彈藥補充、射擊訓練及指揮，而不在追求裝備數量。
kitsEn: The equipment available in 1925 was still dominated by Chinese, Japanese, and European weapons inherited from the First World War era. No armored vehicles or modern air forces were capable of deciding the campaign. National Revolutionary Army infantry primarily used the Hanyang Type 88 rifle and Mauser Type 1889 and Type 1905 rifles. Chen Jiongming's troops used the same general rifle family alongside Japanese Arisaka Type 38 rifles. Representative machine guns included the Maxim M1897 and Schwarzlose M1907/12. Artillery included the Hanyang 88 mm field gun and Krupp 75 mm mountain gun. The former was suitable for curved fire where roads and firing sectors allowed, while the latter could be transported in separate loads by horses or pack animals and could more readily move along eastern Guangdong's routes. Infantry units also possessed Brandt 60 mm mortars, Mills hand grenades, and military bayonets, while officers commonly carried Browning M1903 pistols or Mauser C96 pistols. A limited number of Ford Model T trucks could provide short-haul transport between rear depots in Guangzhou and forward supply points, but poor roads, damaged bridges, fuel shortages, and vehicle condition prevented them from replacing animal and cart transport. Issue was uneven across formations, and many regional units still employed older weapons. Combat performance therefore depended more on ammunition supply, marksmanship, and command than on the nominal amount of equipment.
tactics: 東征採行以黃埔軍校學生部隊為先鋒、受整編地方軍為主力、步炮工協同的縱隊作戰。前衛沿東莞至惠陽的道路快速推進，先以小分隊搜索橋梁、隘口和敵軍警戒線，主力則在後方分批行軍，避免全軍同時壓上一條道路。進入淡水、海豐及潮汕方向後，75毫米山炮被部署於道路轉折與射界開闊處，88式野戰炮負責較遠程火力；步兵則利用河岸坡地、樹林和城鎮外圍展開， machine gun以側翼火力封鎖道路，迫擊炮支援機槍射界。各路部隊不只沿一條公路推進，而是以相鄰縱隊保持聯繫，防止敵軍由側翼插入。陳炯明部依托固定陣地和交通要點防守，依海豐、潮陽至汕頭外圍的縱深遲滯東征軍，並以粵東兵力向廣州方向實施反攻，使東征軍補給線拉長。接到進攻廣州的消息後，東征軍分批回師，在廣州東郊及增埗方向重新集中兵力，以炮火掩護步兵封鎖反攻部隊的進出口，再組織側翼搜索和追擊。五月再次向粵東推進時，重點仍是奪取道路、城鎮與補給節點，而非對陳軍實施一次性的包圍殲滅；受制於交通和後勤，各路部隊未能同步完成遠距離機動。
tacticsEn: The expedition used columns in which Whampoa units formed the vanguard, reorganized regional troops provided the main body, and infantry, artillery, and engineers operated together. The advance guard moved rapidly along the road from Dongguan toward Huizhou, using small detachments to search bridges, defiles, and enemy pickets, while the main force marched in separate echelons to prevent the entire army from crowding onto one road. Beyond Danshui and Haifeng toward Chaoshan, 75 mm mountain guns were placed at road bends and in positions with broad firing sectors, while the Hanyang 88 mm field guns provided longer-range fire. Infantry deployed on riverbanks, wooded slopes, and around the approaches to towns. Machine-gun teams used flanking fire to seal roads, and mortars supported those positions. The formations advanced on neighboring axes rather than relying on a single highway, maintaining lateral contact to prevent enemy insertion. Chen Jiongming's troops used fixed positions and transport nodes to impose delay along the axis from Haifeng through Chaoyang to the approaches of Shantou, while forces from eastern Guangdong counterattacked toward Guangzhou and stretched the expedition's supply line. On receiving reports of the threat to Guangzhou, the columns returned in successive formations, concentrated around the eastern outskirts of the city and the Zengbu sector, used artillery to cover the blocking action, and then conducted flank searches and pursuit. During the renewed eastward advance in May, the operational objective remained the seizure of roads, towns, and supply nodes rather than a single decisive encirclement. Transport and logistics prevented the dispersed columns from completing long-range movements simultaneously.
data: 時間線可概括為二月下旬至五月，前後約三個月。二月下旬，廣州舉行東征誓師並完成第一批兵員、武器與糧食集中；三月上旬，主力離開廣州，經東莞、惠陽向淡水及海豐方向推進。三月中下旬，戰線沿海岸道路和東江水系轉向潮陽、澄海，汕頭外圍成為主要作戰方向。四月上旬，陳炯明所部向廣州反攻，東征軍因而回師，戰鬥重心一度移至廣州東郊與增埗方向；反攻被挫敗後，軍隊在五月再次東進，控制粵東主要交通節點並迫使陳部放棄部分外圍陣地。廣州至潮汕的單程公路距離超過四百公里，前進不能一次完成。彈藥由後方兵站裝載，步槍與機槍彈藥以連排及後勤分隊攜帶為主，山炮依賴馬匹和馱畜，88式野戰炮則需拆件轉運；前線無法長期維持大量預備炮彈。廣汕鐵路潮州至汕頭一線及港口可承擔部分後勤，但線路受戰事、車源和裝卸能力限制，並非全軍能使用的連續運輸幹線。雙方戰報體系不同，傷亡總數無法可靠核定，因此不應以未經核實的精確數字判斷戰果。
dataEn: The campaign can be placed between late February and May 1925, a period of roughly three months. In late February, a mobilization and departure ceremony was held in Guangzhou, and the first concentrations of personnel, weapons, and provisions were completed. In early March, the main force departed Guangzhou and advanced through Dongguan and Huizhou toward Danshui and Haifeng. During the second half of March, the front shifted along the coastal roads and waterways of the Xinfeng River system toward Chaoyang and Chenghai, making the approaches to Shantou the principal operational sector. In early April, Chen Jiongming's forces counterattacked toward Guangzhou. The expedition consequently turned back, and the center of combat briefly shifted to the eastern outskirts of Guangzhou and the Zengbu area. After that counterattack was defeated, the army moved east again in May, seized key communications points in eastern Guangdong, and forced Chen's troops to abandon some of their outer positions. The one-way road distance from Guangzhou to Chaoshan exceeded 400 kilometers, and no advance could be completed in a single movement. Ammunition moved from rear depots, with rifle and machine-gun ammunition carried mainly by company, platoon, and logistics detachments. Mountain guns depended on horses and pack animals, while the Hanyang 88 mm field gun had to be transported in separated loads. The front could not maintain a large reserve of artillery ammunition for long periods. The Chaozhou-Shantou section of the Guangzhou-Shantou Railway and the port could handle part of the logistics, but fighting, limited rolling stock, and restricted loading capacity prevented the line from serving as a continuous trunk route for the entire army. The two sides used incompatible reporting systems, so overall casualty totals cannot be reliably reconstructed and unverified precise figures should not be used to judge the result.
cause: 東征的直接背景是陳炯明與孫中山在廣州政治、軍事領導權上的破裂。1924年末，陳部再度集結兵力進攻並包圍廣州，使廣州國民政府無法集中力量處理省外軍閥。陳炯明既要保有自己在廣東的軍隊、財源與地盤，也拒絕接受一個凌駕於各地方軍事集團之上的中央軍權；對他而言，國民政府的黨政整頓、軍隊集中和外省部隊介入，都是削弱其地位的變化。孫中山一方則必須先解除廣州東翼的軍事威脅，統一粵東交通與資源，取得穩定後方，才可能把新整編的國民革命軍用於北伐。因而此役並非單純的省界爭奪，而是陳炯明地方軍政聯盟與廣州中央政府爭奪廣東主導權的結果；新式軍校教育、蘇俄顧問制度和國共合作帶來的整軍能力，是孫中山能夠發動主動攻勢的條件，卻不是替代軍事與政治原因的口號。
causeEn: The immediate background to the expedition was the political and military rupture between Chen Jiongming and Sun Yat-sen over control of Guangzhou. At the end of 1924, Chen's forces assembled again and attacked and surrounded Guangzhou, preventing the Nationalist Government from concentrating on the military groups outside Guangdong. Chen sought to preserve his own army, financial resources, and territorial base and refused to accept a central military authority placed above the regional armed groups. From his perspective, the Nationalist Government's party and political reorganization, concentration of troops, and entry of contingents from other provinces all threatened his position. Sun's side had to remove the military threat from Guangzhou's eastern flank, unify the communications and resources of eastern Guangdong, and secure a stable rear before employing the reorganized National Revolutionary Army in a northern campaign. The expedition was therefore not a simple provincial boundary dispute. It was the outcome of a struggle between Chen's regional military-political coalition and the Guangzhou central government over control of Guangdong. The new academy training, Soviet advisory arrangements, and cooperation between the Kuomintang and Communist organizations made it possible for Sun's side to initiate an offensive, but these were the conditions for military reorganization rather than substitutes for the underlying political and strategic causes.
impact: 東征最重要的實際影響，是把廣州的安全範圍向東延伸，並使東莞、惠陽、潮陽及潮汕方向的交通價值重新進入中央軍的作戰計算。粵東一旦受控，廣汕鐵路和汕頭港便可成為向軍隊輸送彈藥、糧食與政治命令的戰略通道，儘管這種控制在1925至1926年間仍會反覆。另一項長期影響來自黃埔軍校：大批早期畢業生在真實的遠距離行軍、炮兵協同和追擊戰中取得經驗，返回後成為新軍各級指揮骨幹，國民革命軍因而在同年北伐時擁有較統一的指揮語言與一批受過實戰訓練的幹部。制度上，黨代表、政治部、參謀和後勤被嵌入作戰體系，使廣州政府由地方軍聯盟逐步轉向中央化的軍事機器。但東征沒有消除全部地方武裝，也沒有解決軍隊經費、黨政控制與軍事命令之間的矛盾。陳炯明及其盟友仍保有網絡，黃埔系與地方軍系之間的資源分配也開始顯出分歧，這些問題在1926年第二次東征和後續北伐中更為突出。
impactEn: The most practical effect of the expedition was the extension of Guangzhou's secure military area eastward, placing the communications routes through Dongguan, Huizhou, Chaoyang, and Chaoshan back within the central government's operational calculations. Once eastern Guangdong could be controlled, the Guangzhou-Shantou Railway and the port of Shantou could serve as strategic channels for delivering ammunition, provisions, and political instructions to the army, although that control remained contested from 1925 into 1926. A second long-term effect came through the Whampoa Military Academy. Large numbers of early graduates acquired practical experience in long marches, combined-arms coordination, and pursuit, and returned to become commanders in the newly formed army. The National Revolutionary Army consequently entered the Northern Expedition later that year with a more common command language and a cadre of academy graduates who had already faced combat. Institutionally, party representatives, political departments, staffs, and logistics were incorporated into the operational system, helping the Guangzhou government move from a loose regional military coalition toward a centralized military organization. The expedition did not eliminate every local armed group or resolve tensions among funding, party control, and military command. Chen Jiongming and his allies retained their networks, and competition over resources and authority between the Whampoa group and regional military leaders began to emerge. Those unresolved issues became more visible during the Second Eastern Expedition of 1926 and the subsequent Northern Expedition.
result: 從1925年二月至五月的直接軍事結果看，東征是一次有明確成果但未完成最終政治目標的行動。蔣介石所指揮的部隊挫敗陳炯明對廣州的主動反攻，迫使陳部退出廣州東南外圍的主要攻勢地域，並在五月取得粵東若干城鎮與交通節點，使廣州國民政府第一次能較穩定地運用向粵東的補給和通信線。黃埔軍校學生軍由受訓部隊轉為有實戰經驗的建軍核心，國民革命軍的突擊、追擊和戰後整編能力亦由此形成。不過，陳炯明的政治聯盟、地方關係和相當部分殘餘武裝並未被一次消滅，陳部仍能在後來捲入粵東衝突，最終需要1926年的第二次東征才能完成對其主要軍力的最後打擊。因此，本役不能被等同於廣東永久統一，更不能被說成已完成全國統一；其準確歷史位置，是中央軍在中國內戰中取得的一次重要戰術勝利，以及建立更大規模軍事行動能力的先導戰役。
resultEn: In terms of the direct military outcome between February and May 1925, the expedition was a clear operational success that did not accomplish its final political objective. Chiang Kai-shek's forces defeated Chen Jiongming's principal offensive against Guangzhou, forced Chen's army away from the main offensive approaches southeast of the city, and secured several towns and communications nodes in eastern Guangdong in May. This allowed the Guangzhou Nationalist Government to use the routes into eastern Guangdong more reliably for supply and communication. Whampoa units moved from being an academy formation to the core of a combat-experienced army, while the National Revolutionary Army developed its capacities for rapid attack, pursuit, and post-campaign reorganization. Nevertheless, Chen's political coalition, local relationships, and a substantial part of his residual armed network were not eliminated in one campaign. His forces remained capable of renewing the struggle in eastern Guangdong and ultimately required the Second Eastern Expedition of 1926 to inflict the decisive defeat on his main military force. The 1925 expedition therefore cannot be equated with the permanent unification of Guangdong, much less with national unification. Its proper historical position is that of an important tactical victory for the central army within Chinese civil war and a precursor to the larger military campaigns that followed.
